definitions.full: H8206. Shuppim שֻׁמִּים proper name, masculine 1. ׳שׁ 1Chr 7:15 , Μαμφειν , A Σεφφειμ , ᵐ5 L Σαφιν , apparently = שֻׁמִּם 7:12 , Σαπφειν , ᵐ5 L Σαφαν (compare שְׁפוּפָם שֻׁמִּים, ). 2 שֻׁמִּים door-keeper, 1Chr 26:16 .
definitions.rootNote: plural of an unused noun from the same as 8207 and meaning the same; serpents ;

occurrences.englishText: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.
Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.
To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.
